day.title: Long table brunch
day.guest: Do you have vegan options at brunch? We’re 4.
day.reply: Yes, vegan dishes are marked (V) on the brunch menu. I can hold a table for 4 at 1 PM, close to the music. Shall I?

evening.title: Dinner & the golden hour
evening.guest: Can we book a terrace table for 6 at 8?
evening.reply: The terrace has one table for 6 left at 8:15. I can hold it for 15 minutes and send the confirmation on WhatsApp.

night.title: [Headliner] all night long
night.guest: Is there a guestlist tonight? We’re 6.
night.reply: Yes, the guestlist is open until 10:30. For 6 people a table has a minimum spend. Want me to add you and send details on WhatsApp?
